description: This file defines the EndpointDefinitionProvider class responsible for providing endpoint rulesets, tests, and partition data used in endpoint resolution and testing within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods to retrieve rulesets, tests, partition data, and the latest API versions for services.

classes.name: EndpointDefinitionProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods for retrieving endpoint rulesets, tests, partitions, and latest API versions for AWS services.

methods.name: getEndpointRuleset
methods.description: Returns endpoint ruleset data for a specified AWS service and API version.

methods.name: getEndpointTests
methods.description: Returns endpoint test data for a specified AWS service and API version.

methods.name: getPartitions
methods.description: Retrieves partition data for AWS endpoints.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Internal method to fetch ruleset or test data from files for a given service and API version.

methods.name: getLatest
methods.description: Retrieves the latest API version for a given AWS service.
